text: dsh-liquid-chatbox 是面向 DSH 桌面界面的液态玻璃 composer 卡片主题。客户端向输入卡片注入半透明样式和 SVG 位移折射滤镜，并提供模糊、色调、折射强度与色散设置，设置可立即应用并保存在本地。适合希望调整 DSH 输入区域视觉效果的用户；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-liquid-chatbox adds liquid-glass refraction to the DSH composer card. It injects translucent styling and an SVG displacement filter, with controls for blur, tint, refraction, and dispersion. Settings persist locally. It needs no API key or external service.

dsh-liquid-chatbox README · About：A liquid-glass **composer card** for the DSH desktop UI (Electron/Chromium).
Only the input card is styled: it keeps a translucent tint and refracts the
content behind it with an SVG displacement lens plus per-channel chromatic
dispersion.

There is **no palette, font, window rim or global surface restyling** in this
package. It is a client-only bundle — no build step, no native dependencies.

dsh-liquid-chatbox README · Features：- **Refractive composer card** — the input card bends the content behind it
  with an SVG `feDisplacementMap`, using a BK7 glass model and a convex rim
  profile.
- **Chromatic dispersion** — three displaced copies (R, G, B at their own
  refractive indices) isolated with `feColorMatrix` and screen-blended.
- **Card-shaped map** — the displacement map is generated from the card's
  actual aspect ratio and corner radius, and regenerated when the card grows
  or shrinks, so the lens band stays on the border instead of drifting.
- **Symmetric edges** — top and bottom sample toward the card centre, so both
  borders show the same lens behaviour.
- **Settings** — *Settings → General → 玻璃质感*: blur, card tint, refraction
  strength and dispersion, with a reset button. Values persist in
  `localStorage` under `dsh-glass-settings`.
- **No build step** — plain ESM loaded by the DSH client module loader.

dsh-liquid-chatbox README · Requirements：- DSH desktop app. The lens filter is mounted on `dsh-app://`; in a plain
  browser the card keeps its tint and blur, but the SVG lens is not mounted.
- Chromium-based renderer (`backdrop-filter: url(#svgFilter)` is
  Chromium-only).
- Windows 11 is recommended for the window material; the card still works on
  any page, but the acrylic backdrop is what makes the refraction visible
  when there is no content behind the card.

dsh-liquid-chatbox README · Option A — manual (profile)：1. Copy this folder into your DSH profile:

```
   %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-liquid-chatbox
   ```

2. Add the plugin to `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: liquid-chatbox
         name: dsh-liquid-chatbox
   ```

3. Restart the DSH desktop app.

dsh-liquid-chatbox README · Option A — manual (profile)：> pnpm may prune packages that are not in the profile's dependency tree. If
> you manage the profile with pnpm, register the plugin as a `file:` dependency
> (or install it as a bundle) so it is not moved to `node_modules/.ignored`.

dsh-liquid-chatbox README · Option B — bundle/plugin manager：The package ships its own `cordis.patch.yml` (`dsh.bundle.patch`), so a manager
that understands the DSH bundle format can install it. Install the package,
then restart the app.

dsh-liquid-chatbox README · Usage：Open *Settings → General* and scroll to **玻璃质感**. The sliders apply
immediately; “恢复默认” resets blur `0.5px`, tint `18%`, refraction `0.04` and
dispersion `2.5`.

dsh-liquid-chatbox README · How it works：- `client.js` injects one `<style>` element and mounts the lens SVG filter
  (`#dsh-lg-refract`) used by the composer card.
- The displacement map is generated at runtime from a rounded-rect SDF whose
  aspect ratio and radius match the card; the band is 36px wide (scaled with
  the card width) and the profile is monotonic, so the mapping never folds.
- The card uses:

dsh-liquid-chatbox README · How it works：```css
  backdrop-filter: blur(0.5px) url(#dsh-lg-refract)
                   contrast(1.05) brightness(1.1) saturate(1.8);
  ```

- Dispersion uses three displaced copies (R, G, B) isolated with
  `feColorMatrix` and screen-blended.

dsh-liquid-chatbox README · Changes in 0.2.0：- Scope reduced to the composer card: the pink accent, Maple Mono overrides,
  glass window rim and global surface restyling were removed.
- The displacement map now matches the card's aspect ratio and corner radius
  and is regenerated on resize, fixing the band drifting away from the border.
- Top and bottom edges sample symmetrically toward the card centre, so the
  bottom border shows the same reflection as the top.
- Reverted to a monotonic rim profile: the previous bump profile could fold the
  mapping and make text appear to move backwards inside the band.

dsh-liquid-chatbox README · Known limitations：- `backdrop-filter` samples the **page's** painted backdrop, not the DWM
  material/desktop. The acrylic stays live, but the lens cannot refract the
  material itself.
- A displaced sample that lands on a translucent pixel can let the original
  content show through the semi-transparent filter result (a faint edge ghost).
  Making the output opaque removes it but replaces the vacated pixels with the
  page colour, because the material colour is not part of the filter input.
- The lens needs something behind the card. Over a flat area there is nothing
  to bend, so the effect is invisible there.
- Large blur/refraction on a sticky, scrolling surface is GPU/CPU heavy; the
  defaults are kept small.

dsh-liquid-chatbox README · Development：```
node --check client.js
```

- `index.js` — empty host half.
- `client.js` — the whole client plugin (styles + filter + settings row).
- `locale/*.json` — catalogue metadata.
- `icon.svg` — plugin icon.

No dependencies, no build.

dsh-liquid-chatbox README · Credits：The refraction model and edge-bulge idea are derived from two MIT-licensed
projects:

- [sohumsuthar/liquid-glass](https://github.com/sohumsuthar/liquid-glass) — BK7
  refraction model and displacement-map approach.
- [shuding/liquid-glass](https://github.com/shuding/liquid-glass) — edge-bulge
  (`applyEdgeBulge`) convex-lens idea.
